Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{compact_tables: true}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
